elements.text: Flight crew operated the airplane below the minimum descent altitude without appropriate visual reference for the runway
FAA's unclear wording of the Notice to Airmen regarding nighttime restriction for the VOR/DME-C approach
FAA's failure to communicate the nighttime landing restriction to the Aspen tower
Inability of the flight crew to adequately see the mountainous terrain due to darkness and weather conditions
Pressure on the captain to land from the charter customer
Pressure on the captain due to the airplane's delayed departure
Pressure on the captain due to the airport's nighttime landing restriction
